historical_manifest_policy: Frozen historical inventories retain original pins. Omitted raw-header/private inputs are not satisfied by sanitized derivative metadata; no entire historical inventory is asserted public.
primary_input_exclusion: All full third-party PDFs/text/HTML/API bodies/ZIP/source members, raw private captures and vendor runtimes are excluded.
private_path_metadata: INPUT_PINS and related owned source metadata can contain private/local paths. They are not blindly exported into this author selection; source retrieval and exact future MAIN metadata eligibility are separate.

replay_limits.original_four_checkers: Included unchanged original programs/receipts; declared SymPy/mpmath libraries; no private source-body reads.
replay_limits.archive_check_algebra: Owned standalone standard-library polynomial checker in the intended original archive public location, omitted from these report exports.
replay_limits.general_reduction_and_comparison: Owned SymPy/mpmath checkers at intended original general-theorem location; omitted from author exports.
replay_limits.fresh_priority_authentication: verify_adversarial.py authenticates excluded private primary inputs, writes receipts, and contains an absolute prior-case vendor-library path. Publishing its owned code does not make that unchanged harness portable; local staging/source fetch and a separately reviewed portability adaptation are required.
replay_limits.root_authentication_wrappers: Owned Root wrappers can authenticate separate family files and private input pins/use isolated local libraries. This author packet contains their dated receipts, not a complete runnable environment.
